0x000873.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0008E4.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x00096C.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A95.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000ACD.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000B96.en: 「Guh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000BD1.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny at all...」

0x000C25.en: 「Blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000C99.en: 「Guh! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D0F.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D76.en: 「This is it... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000DA8.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is where it ends!」

0x000DE4.en: 「Nngh! Got the worse of it, did I...」

0x000E22.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000E6F.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EAD.en: 「Kyaah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000EF4.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F9F.en: 「Guh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x00101E.en: 「I-I can't take any more of this...!」

0x001056.en: 「Owowow... I give. A miscalculation on my part.」

0x001097.en: 「Ah, dang it! They got me good!」

0x001148.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00118F.en: 「I'm sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x0011C4.en: 「Damn! Is this as far as my power goes...!」

0x001208.en: 「I can't fight any longer! Pulling back!」

0x0012B0.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ How green of me...!」

0x0012FE.en: 「No good, I can't hold out! Retreating!」

0x0013E8.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001426.en: 「Well, well... so this is the end.」

0x001455.en: 「I can't manage any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x0014E0.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x00155D.en: 「Tch...! I can't hold out after all...!」

0x001646.en: 「Ejecting...@ Ngh...! Can't even do it with style...」

0x001704.en: 「Nnngh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001844.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x0018D4.en: 「A-all hands!@　Make abandoning ship your top priority...!!」

0x001998.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Langran State, Royal Capital

0x001A04.en: 「...Your Highness, word came from General Kirkus@ regarding the date and place of the coronation.@ The details are here.」

0x001A91.en: 「...I see... sooner than I expected.@ So he had no intention of holding it in the capital after all.」

0x001B0B.en: 「Summoning Your Highness like this is the height of insolence.@ And broadcasting the ceremony besides...」

0x001B7F.en: 「Kirkus means to use this chance to flaunt his power@ before the common people as well.」

0x001BFA.en: 「And regarding your escort, how shall we proceed?」

0x001C34.en: 「I intend to request Masaki's Elemental Lords@ and the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x001C84.en: 「I see...@ With the Hagane, even Kirkus won't dare make a careless move.」

0x001CE3.en: 「Yes. Had the interceptor carrier been finished,@ we wouldn't need to trouble them...」

0x001D5A.en: 「Construction has fallen behind@ due to that affair with Shutedonias...」

0x001DBF.en: 「At the very least I want the Duraxil operational.@ There's a chance General Kirkus is still@ continuing the Super Elemental project.」

0x001ECF.en: 「The reason you called me... is it the Duraxil?」

0x001F15.en: 「Exactly. I want to resume its tuning.」

0x001F99.en: 「Yes, and the development staff are assembled too.」

0x001FD6.en: 「So it'll take about two or three more days to finish it.@　I'd really have liked to tune it after seeing the@　Huckebein Mk-II and Mk-III up close, but...」

0x00209C.en: 「We fixed the frame and joint strength issues@　by resizing the unit and reinforcing it,@　so it should be fine.」

0x00212F.en: 「I guarantee it'll outperform the Elemental Lords@ and the surface humanoid mecha.」

0x002185.en: 「I'm counting on you.@ Now, about Terius's coronation...@ I mean to request the Steel Dragons as my escort.」

0x002252.en: 「If I don't go, there's no point to any of this.」

0x0022A5.en: 「No, you should stay with the Duraxil...」

0x0022DC.en: 「I'm worried about you and Terius.@ I'll leave instructions for the staff on the Duraxil@ and finish it in one push once we're back.」

0x0023E7.en: 「That coronation, huh...@ Does the prince really mean to recognize it?」

0x002446.en: 「Yes... though in exchange he means to hold@ some leverage over Kirkus.」

0x0024B1.en: 「Waste of time, if you ask me.@ Once you hand Kirkus a proper excuse,@ won't he just become impossible to deal with?」

0x00254D.en: 「You're right...@ But there's no use arguing about it here and now.@ During the coronation, we have to protect the prince...」

0x0025EF.en: 「Hey, hey, are you two heading out?」

0x002620.en: 「Off to Ballantyne State for a bit.」

0x002657.en: 「Then bring me back a pennant and a skull keychain@ for a souvenir.」

0x0026B0.en: 「Who still sells stuff like that these days!」

0x00271B.en: 「Huh, really? Then maybe I'll look for my own.@ Like one of those keychains with the pop-out eyes,@ or a little Tokyo Tower figurine.」

0x0027C3.en: 「...There's no way you'll find Tokyo souvenirs in Langran.」

0x002828.en: 「So this is the Hagane's first bridge...」

0x002856.en: 「There are fewer crew than I expected.」

0x002899.en: 「The Space Noah-class multipurpose battleship@ is automated as far as possible.@ Now then, Your Highness... please, the admiral's seat.」

0x002956.en: 「Thank you.@ I'll observe your handling of things, Lieutenant Commander.」

0x0029C5.en: 「...So that's Langran's prince...@ He's even more handsome than on the monitor.」

0x002A3D.en: 「The whole group's fascinated by the ship.@ Guess they don't have space battleships@ down in La Gias.」

0x002AD0.en: 「You there! No idle chatter! The prince is right here!」

0x002B2C.en: 「Hmm... this ship seems to have a few problems@ where discipline is concerned.」

0x002B8B.en: 「It's fine.@ I think being too rigid has its own drawbacks.」

0x002BDB.en: 「No. This is the military, so discipline matters.」

0x002C3D.en: (If I say anything more, I'll be in for a lecture too...)

0x002C89.en: (Th-this feels kind of like a parents' visiting day...)

0x002CBD.en: 「The ship is now entering launch sequence!@ All hands, to your stations!」

0x002D19.en: 「Hmm... it's quite impressive that a body this large@ can fly without any trouble.」

0x002DAF.en: 「Captain, a message from Kirkus's forces.@ It's for Prince Feil.」

0x002E11.en: 「Then route it through to the prince.」

0x002EB1.en: 「They say the coronation is being postponed.@ The reason... High Priest Zabod has taken ill.」

0x002F50.en: 「And they ask us to return to the capital for now.@ ...Zabod's illness is likely a lie.@ Something may have happened over there.」

0x00301C.en: 「Or it could be a trap...@ Let me contact General Kirkus and press him on it.」

0x003084.en: 「No, that's all right.@ ...Lieutenant Commander Tetsuya, please reply@ that we accept.」

0x003115.en: 「Yes, I'll watch how things unfold for a while.@ I'd like the Hagane to stand by here...」

0x0031D6.en: 「Your Highness, what in the world is going on!?」

0x00324A.en: 「It's fine. Masaki wouldn't be any fun otherwise.」

0x003290.en: 「That bastard Kirkus is looking down on us!@ We're not a bunch of kids running errands!」

0x00330A.en: 「No, I believe something unforeseen@ has happened over there.」

0x00337F.en: 「Something inconvenient for General Kirkus...@ and that he doesn't want the prince to know?」

0x003461.en: 「Yes, I've looked through all the material@ on the Hagane's forces.」

0x0034C0.en: (...Impressive. He's earned his place leading an army)

0x003557.en: 「Ah, Your Highness... I-I'm sorry.@ I didn't expect you to be here...」

0x0035FC.en: 「We just received an emergency broadcast...@ The coronation is starting right now!」

0x003689.en: 「Wasn't the ceremony supposed to be postponed...!?」

0x0036C0.en: 「This...@ Your Highness's prediction may have come true.」

0x003713.en: 「...Masaki, can you put that footage up@ so we can see it here?」

0x0037DB.en: 「...Amid solemn silence, His Majesty Terius Gran Bilseia,@ 288th king of Holy Langran, is about to be crowned.」

0x0038A1.en: 「High Priest Zabod's proclamation of accession@ echoes through the silence.」

0x003914.en: 「...under the blessing of the spirits, and@　in the name of your mother, Natalia Zoram Lakshmi,@　and your father, Alzar Gran Bilseia...」

0x003A56.en: 「Novus, come with me. There's something we must discuss.」

0x003AAC.en: 「Masaki, is there somewhere Novus and I can speak alone?」

0x003AF8.en: 「Then use my room on the Hagane.」

0x003B3F.en: 「Masaki, you never clean that place, do you?@　And now you're taking His Highness there...」

0x003BB3.en: 「T-this is no time to worry about that!」

0x003BF9.en: 「Quite right. Sorry, but lead the way.」

0x003C33.en: 「Novus...@　that Terius may not be the real one.」

0x003CA5.en: 「Terius and I are half-brothers.@　His mother was Natalia... said to be of noble birth.」

0x003D50.en: 「The truth is otherwise. She was true royalty.@　Only Terius and I@　know of this now, but...」

0x003DF8.en: 「That is... but why would such a thing...?」

0x003E3B.en: 「...She was born of the Noland house.」

0x003EB2.en: 「That is wrong!@　There is a hidden truth behind that.@　Terius told me so himself.」

0x003F33.en: 「Terius took pride in his mother's lineage.@　The proof: gentle as he was, just once@　he flew into a rage.」

0x003FCF.en: 「It was over a matter concerning Natalia.@　Terius never forgave anyone who scorned her.@　To him, his mother was true royalty.」

0x00408F.en: 「Then why was she called Zoram just now, in that recitation?@ If she were royalty, it should be Grania...」

0x004121.en: 「Exactly.@　Terius holds fierce pride where his mother is concerned.@　If that were the real Terius, he'd never let her be called so.」

0x0041C9.en: 「I see...@　So that's why Kirkus arranged to keep@　His Highness away from the coronation.」

0x00425C.en: 「Yes...@ Xenia or I would know the moment we met him face to face.」

0x0042BB.en: 「What shall we do?@　Shall we lodge a protest with Kirkus?」

0x004311.en: 「No, we've no proof. When it comes to Natalia,@ only Terius and I know the truth.」

0x004385.en: 「Then let us search for the real Prince Terius.@　They gave a flimsy excuse about Lord Zabod@　taking ill. The other side must be in disarray.」

0x004451.en: 「Mm... depending on how this plays out,@　we may have to cross swords with Kirkus's army...」

0x0044C2.en: 「I see, I understand the situation.@　So, any idea where Prince Terius might be?」

0x00453C.en: 「I was thinking of having Xenia look into it, but...」

0x004585.en: 「Captain, sorry to interrupt, but...@　may I have a word?」

0x0045EE.en: 「At twelve o'clock, about ten kilometers out,@　we're picking up multiple Elemental readings.」

0x004662.en: 「Their movement is odd...@　Looks like several units are chasing one down.」

0x0046CA.en: 「Any unit deployed around here would be Kirkus's army...@　Are they running an exercise?」

0x004744.en: 「Maybe...!@　Commander, could you head that way?」

0x0047A3.en: 「Understood.@　To be safe, I'll order all hands to Condition One.」

0x00480F.en: 「Stop this, Prince Terius.@　If you resist any further, we'll have no choice@　but to take stronger measures.」

0x0048C1.en: 「Good grief...@　Leslie, is the shadow-bind ready?」

0x004999.en: 「Listen well, Your Highness. Our orders leave@　the question of life or death open... but we intend@　to bring you home safe and sound.」

0x004A59.en: 「However, if you keep throwing tantrums,@　we can't guarantee your safety...」

0x004ABC.en: 「Major Acros,@　a surface-dweller warship is approaching!」

0x004B0F.en: 「Tch, they noticed.@ Ensign Lioness, contact Lord Ahmed.」

0x004BED.en: 「It's useless, Prince Terius. Royal blood or no,@　none escape this shadow-bind.@　Now, do be still.」

0x004C92.en: 「The one riding that Gadifall...@　it's Terius!」

0x004D2B.en: 「And he stole an Elemental... that boy did...」

0x004D6B.en: 「Masaki, Tytti, help Terius.@　That'll be the key to breaking Kirkus's scheme.」

0x004E0D.en: (All I can do is buy time till reinforcements come.)

0x004E47.en: 「...You're a unit of Kirkus's army.@　I am the pilot of the Elemental Lord Gaddess,@　Tytti Norbuck.」

0x004EE3.en: 「I know you well.@　I am Ratel Acros. My rank is Major.」

0x004F48.en: 「And what brings you all the way out here...@　what business do you have?」

0x005030.en: 「...Major Acros, we've come to take back@　Prince Terius, who's right there.」

0x0050D2.en: 「One moment, Lady Tytti.@　Prince Terius is vital to us as well.@　We cannot hand him over. Even if...」

0x005180.en: 「Even if you have to kill us... is that it?」

0x0051F6.en: 「Impossible, breaking the shadow-bind...!@　Royal magic runs high, but no human could do that!」

0x00528C.en: 「Haah, haah... I'm... I'm done with this!!@　Done being ordered around by everyone...」

0x005300.en: 「That power... I'll take it into my keeping.」

0x00542E.en: 「Terius, I have seen your power.@　With strength like that, you've nothing to fear.@　Come, now. Come to my side.」

0x00552E.en: 「Yes, I need your power.@　But I won't force you.@　Your own will is what matters.」

0x005607.en: 「...I-I've always felt like@　I was hiding in someone else's shadow...」

0x005675.en: 「But... Christoph... if you need my power...@　if you need someone like me to exist...」

0x0056E6.en: 「Then take me... take me with you...!」

0x00579B.en: 「Sister Xenia, Masaki...@ I'm going with Christoph.@ I've decided... don't try to stop me...!」

0x005834.en: 「Wait, Terius!@　Do you mean to give up your claim to the throne!?」

0x00588A.en: 「B-brother... not even you@　can stop me now...」

0x005946.en: 「Tch! To think that man would get in our way!」

0x0059A5.en: 「First Princess Monica, and now Prince Terius...!@ Damn that Shu, what in the world is he planning!?」

0x005A2B.en: (Christoph... what are you@ planning to make Terius do...?)

0x005A8D.en: 「...Shouldn't we go after@　Shu and His Highness?」

0x005AE3.en: 「That depends... on what that unit does next.」

0x005BB3.en: 「There's no help for it.@　I'll report to General Kirkus exactly as it happened.」

0x005C2E.en: 「True, my orders say that if capture proves impossible,@　I'm to assassinate him... but I cannot do that.」

0x005CB1.en: 「But then it would go public that we crowned@ a false Prince Terius, and General Kirkus's@ reputation would collapse!」

0x005D7B.en: 「...That's so. That would be a bad thing.」

0x005E45.en: 「Of course there is! The man's a usurper!」

0x005E9E.en: 「U-sur-per!@　Someone who seizes a higher position by force!」

0x005EF7.en: 「My, my, Masa knows some big words.」

0x005F40.en: 「And you say that's a bad thing, Masaki?@　The strong seek a more rightful position.@　I'd call that a natural right.」

0x005FE5.en: 「Look at the state of Langran and then talk!」

0x006025.en: 「...I know all too well what war is.@　More than I ever wanted to.@　On the surface, and in this world too.」

0x0060D1.en: 「Listen. Once war has broken out,@　the best thing is to end it as fast as possible.@　And for that, you back whoever has the power.」

0x0061B6.en: 「Before god, one man's malice amounts to little.@　And Kirkus is hardly what I'd call evil.」

0x00623F.en: 「Even your Prince Feil-Lord@　is no saint, as far as I can see.」

0x0062D2.en: 「A difference of views, that's all, Ahmed.@　So, what do you intend to do?」

0x00633A.en: 「You'll all die here. To keep you quiet.」

0x00637D.en: 「You'd say that with Prince Feil-Lord@　right in front of you!?」

0x0063D0.en: 「If Prince Feil-Lord is here, all the better.@　This one battle may be the spark@　that settles Langran's turmoil.」

0x0064B8.en: 「Yeah. I walk the path I believe in.」

0x0064EC.en: 「Wait, Lord Ahmed!@　I'll take full responsibility! So please, here-」

0x006560.en: 「Even if you die to take responsibility,@　the facts won't change.@　Bring Kirkus down now, and war breaks out again.」

0x00660E.en: 「The truth will come to light in time, sure,@　but now is the worst possible moment. So...」

0x0066D2.en: 「Get in my way, and I'll cut you down too.」

0x006709.en: 「Major Acros, Ensign Lioness,@　Lord Ahmed speaks the truth...!」

0x00677D.en: 「Justice lies with Kirkus!@ Let us bring justice down on the Elemental pilot@ serving Prince Feil-Lord, and the surface-dwellers!」

0x006831.en: 「Lieutenant Rasheed is right.@　Remember why you follow Kirkus.」

0x0068A2.en: 「...Understood.@　Lord Masaki, Lady Tytti, prepare yourselves...!」

0x00692A.en: 「So he brought a whole unit with him!」

0x006998.en: 「...Even if we withdraw here,@　Kirkus will send his troops after us.」

0x006A00.en: 「With the Terius affair,@　he's surely resolved to fight us.@　An all-out clash is no longer avoidable...」

0x006A90.en: 「And we cannot afford to fall here.@　Commander Tetsuya, engage them.」

0x006B88.en: 「Tch... not bad.@　Fine, I'll back off quietly this time.」

0x006BEA.en: 「Tch... you've gotten better.@　Fine, I'll back off quietly this time.」

0x006C77.en: 「So from now on it's war against Kirkus's army...」

0x006CC0.en: 「...Masaki, what do we do about Prince Terius?」

0x006D09.en: 「If Ahmed hadn't butted in,@　we could've gone after him...」

0x006D65.en: 「Nothing for it. From Christoph's tone,@　he doesn't seem to mean the boy any harm...」

0x006DEB.en: 「For now, Kirkus's army is the bigger problem.」

0x006E1C.en: 「...Commander, return to the capital at once.@　Kirkus has surely already@　made his next move.」

0x006EAC.en: 「Gah, my unit! I've no choice but to fall back!」

0x006EEC.en: 「To be pushed this far...! I'm retreating!」

0x006F2C.en: 「D-damn it! That my justice should fail...!!」

0x006F75.en: 「We've ended up on opposite sides, Masaki.@　This kind of freedom suits a wind Elemental pilot,@　don't you think?」

0x007005.en: 「Says who!@　I won't let anyone raise a hand against Prince Feil-Lord!」

0x00706D.en: 「Ho... let's see how long you can keep saying that.」

0x0070B6.en: 「What is right, and what is not...@　to decide that once and for all - isn't that arrogant?」

0x00712A.en: 「You've no right to say that@　to us, not as you are now!」

0x00717D.en: 「I won't let you lay a hand on my brother, Ahmed!」

0x0071C0.en: 「Even you, Lady Xenia - this is a battlefield.@ Steel yourself.」

0x007216.en: 「So you're Zamzeed's new pilot.@　But those moves of yours are still green.」

0x007278.en: 「I'll have you know I'm getting better every day!」

0x0072BE.en: 「Ahmed, why are you doing this!?@　Please, just stop!」

0x007332.en: 「So you're piloting Diablo now, Presia.@ Then you've become a full-fledged pilot... I won't hold back.」
